Registered nurse turned quantitative methodologist. Clinical background in emergency and intensive care; research on nursing workforce, team composition and collaboration, using statistical modelling and data science. Works in Python, R and SQL.

## Skills

**Statistical modelling**
: Factor analysis, regression, Bayesian and regularised regression, survival analysis, multilevel modelling, uncertainty quantification.

**Data science**
: Data analysis and engineering, random forests, agent-based simulation.

**Programming**
: Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyMC/NumPyro, BoTorch, Trieste, Mesa), PostgreSQL, R (basic), SPSS, Git/GitHub, Streamlit.

**Research tools**
: Qualtrics (survey design), RevMan (systematic reviews), high-performance computing (VSC cluster).

**Clinical**
: Nursing workforce analytics, team-composition metrics, emergency and ICU experience.
